card.name: Opening of overdose and emergency instructions
card.fires_on: Fires on the word right before an instruction is given, such as "event" in "In the event of", the comma after "In case of accidental overdose", and "calm" in "Stay calm". It marks the point where a directive is about to follow.

modes.label: In the event of
modes.description: The word "event" in "In the event of an overdose" or other problem, just before the instruction.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no clinical experience with NEXLETOL overdose. In the<< event>> of an overdosage, consider contacting

modes.label: Comma after accidental overdose
modes.description: The comma after "In case of accidental overdose" in child-safety warnings.
modes.example: WARNING: Keep out of the reach of children. In case of accidental overdose<<,>> seek professional assistance or contact a Poison Control

modes.label: Stay calm
modes.description: The word "calm" after "Stay" in advice on what to do in a situation.

card.writes: It pushes toward words that open a directive, such as 'please', 'be sure to', 'do not' and 'pay attention to'.
card.plain: It lights up just before the text tells the reader what to do in an emergency or overdose.
